summary_en: Interim dividend increased to 45 yen per share from 40 yen, and full-year dividend forecast raised to 90 yen from 80 yen, reflecting upward revision of fiscal 2027 earnings guidance.
title_en: Notice Regarding Revision of Consolidated Earnings Forecast for Fiscal Year Ending March 2027 and Modification of Interim Dividend and Year-End Dividend Forecast (Dividend Increase)
translation_en_brief:
Macnica Holdings raised its consolidated earnings forecast for fiscal year ending March 2027 by substantial margins: sales revised upward by 370 billion yen to 1.67 trillion yen, operating profit increased by 15.5 billion yen to 67.5 billion yen, and net income attributable to parent company shareholders raised by 14 billion yen to 46 billion yen. The company attributes the upward revision primarily to robust demand in its semiconductor business driven by AI-related applications and strong growth in its cybersecurity business as demand for AI-related security solutions expands both domestically and internationally. The CPS Solutions business faces headwinds from ongoing investment phases in autonomous EV bus development and revised sales plans reflecting changes in overseas business environments.

In line with the improved earnings outlook, the company increased its interim dividend to 45 yen per share from the previous forecast of 40 yen, with an ex-dividend date of September 30, 2026. The year-end dividend forecast was also raised to 45 yen per share from 40 yen. As a result, the full-year dividend per share for fiscal 2027 is now projected at 90 yen, up 10 yen from the previous forecast of 80 yen. The company's dividend policy remains anchored to a consolidated shareholders' equity dividend rate (DOE) target of approximately 5% with a total shareholder return ratio of 40-50%, combining stable, ongoing dividends with opportunistic share buybacks that consider capital efficiency and market conditions.
